compos.text: Alt text: "Consent Notice Reminder screen. The notice informs the user that they have previously consented to Ogury Ltd collecting information from their device to provide relevant content and product support. The data collected may include device, location, email, application, and browsing usage, and may be shared with business partners. The data is tied to the Android Advertising ID, which can be reset via Google Settings > Ads > Reinitialize ad ID. For more information, a link to Ogury's Data Usage Principles is provided: http://www.ogury.co/privacy.html. At the bottom, there is a green 'OK' button."

compos.summarization:
This smartphone UI screen is a "Consent Notice Reminder" from Ogury Ltd. It informs the user that they have previously consented to the collection of information from their device. The collected data is used to provide more relevant content, product support, and to improve services. This consent applies to all apps containing Ogury's technology.

The data collected may include information about the device, location, email, application and browsing usage, and may be shared with select business partners. The data is tied to the user's Android Advertising ID, which can be reset through the path: Google Settings -> Ads -> Reinitialize ads id.

For more details on data usage and protection, a link to Ogury's privacy policy is provided. The user can acknowledge this notice by tapping the "OK" button at the bottom of the screen.
